about_the_game:
Exit 3A: The Game is an arcade-style driving game where you drive through infamous infrastructure in Charlotte without losing your cargo.

Wait, what? Charlotte, North Carolina?

Yes

Realistic Driving Experience

Don't let the arcade driving fool you, this game aims to truly capture the Exit 3A experience. You'll need to dodge inattentive drivers, change lanes with proper turn signal etiquette, avoid angering the Charlotte police department and watch out for the occasional road hazards as you make your way toward NoDa.

Charlotte-Inspired Cargo

Drive along I-277 carrying your favorite cargo including local brewery cans, empty 12-piece chicken boxes, giant red letters 🤷, Crab Volleyball arcade cabinets and more! Each cargo has its own impact on the way the game is played and have unique scoring mechanics.

High Score and Collectables

Your driving impacts your score whether it's finishing a run scratch fee or somehow managing to run into everything. Pick your style and top the leaderboards!

And more!

Check back for more updates, but yes there will be more levels including Bonus rounds based on Charlotte infrastructure!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu >= 20.04, Arch, or similar
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions or any x86_64 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support or better
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 or newer
  • Processor: x86_64 or ARM CPU (Apple Silicon)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support or better
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: Experience Charlotte, NC's infamous infrastructure from the safety of your home! Discover why locals call it "an absolute nightmare" while you dodge traffic and hold on to your cargo. Master the arcade physics, climb the leaderboards and learn what it takes to become a true Charlottean!
